title: Start with meaning; let the editor own structure
summary: Choose a bounded sphere purpose, scaffold it with `gopher sphere edit create`, add one semantic object at a time, attach machine-resolvable provenance, validate, lint, test, qualify, then package. Do not regenerate an entire sphere to change one article.
procedure: Create the scaffold with sphere edit create.
Ask sphere edit template for the canonical object shape; fill semantic content rather than inventing structure.
Insert one exact article/rule/service/corpus object through sphere edit put.
For corpus growth, use record-put so one record changes without reconstructing the whole corpus.
Attach evidence through sphere edit evidence rather than inventing a local citation shape.
Run validate after structural changes and lint before qualification.
Add executable tests for advertised behavior, record qualification evidence, then package.
invariants: A bounded edit must not rewrite unrelated objects.
Useful judgement belongs in articles; mechanically reliable triggers may become rules.
